## 연습문제 6.05.

```{r}
xs <- c(154, 154, 186, 243, 159, 174, 183, 163, 192, 181)
t.test(xs, mu = 160, alternative = "greater")
```

## 연습문제 7.08.

```{r}
pre <- c(4, 4, 3, 4, 3, 2, 6, 6, 5)
post <- c(1, 6, 2, 2, 4, 3, 5, 4, 3)
df <- data.frame(pre, post)
t.test(df$pre, df$post, mu = 0, alternative = "less", paired = TRUE)
```

## 연습문제 7.09.

```{r}
a <- c(77, 81, 80, 78, 79)
b <- c(76, 72, 74, 75, 74, 71, 76)
c <- c(69, 71, 68, 68, 69, 67)
x <- c(a, b, c)

type <- c(rep(1, 5), rep(2, 7), rep(3, 6))
type <- factor(type)
df <- data.frame(type, x)

model <- aov(x ~ type, data = df)
summary(model)
```
